newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's employers hope rate cut boosts economy.
newsitem.headline: Spain's employers hope rate cut boosts economy.

text.p: Spanish employers association CEOE said on Friday it hoped that the latest cut in the official rate by the Bank of Spain would boost growth and employment.
"The trasmission of this reduction to the banking rates to consumers and investors, could have a positive impact over the economic activity and employment," CEOE said.
"The news of a 25-basis-point cut in the interest rate is good. It cames after the positive April trend in inflation", CEOE added.
Earlier on Friday the Bank of Spain cut its key money market by 25 basis points to 5.25 percent.
